Container.Name: chummer-anarchy2
Container.Overview: Character generator and career tracker for Shadowrun: Anarchy 2.0. It's a browser app you run on your own network: create runners with Ganger, Runner or Prime Runner packages, build Shadow Amps, track a career ledger, and print a character sheet. Runners are saved as XML files in the Characters folder (deleted ones go to Characters/.trash). Put overlay XML (house rules, extra gear, private descriptions) in the Custom data folder and list it in custom/index.xml. The app ships no book content: upload your own PDFs on the Books page and they are kept in the Library folder and imported into Custom data/imported. LAN use: there is no login.

Config.Name: Characters
Config.Description: Saved runners, one XML file each

Config.Name: Custom data
Config.Description: House-rule and extra-content XML overlays (list them in index.xml)

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: Your uploaded PDFs, their converted text, import reports and AI settings (keys). Never served over the web.
